description_zh: 删除 RUM 符号文件
name: DeleteRumSymbolFiles

parameters.help_en: The list of object paths of the symbol files to delete. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty array. Set the value to the artifactPath returned by GetRumSymbolFiles. Up to 1,000 paths are supported per call. Only user-uploaded symbol files under the current application can be deleted. System symbol files cannot be deleted
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的符号文件对象路径列表，调用时必须提供且不能为空数组。取值为 GetRumSymbolFiles 返回的 artifactPath，单次最多支持 1000 个路径；仅支持删除当前应用下的用户上传符号文件，不支持删除系统符号文件
parameters.name: file_paths

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RUM application service
parameters.name: service_id

deletedObjectCount.description_en: The actual number of objects that were successfully deleted
deletedObjectCount.description_zh: 实际删除成功的对象数
deletedObjectCount.title_en: 实际删除成功的对象数
deletedObjectCount.title_zh: 实际删除成功的对象数

requestedFileCount.description_en: The number of file paths requested for deletion
requestedFileCount.description_zh: 请求删除的文件路径数
requestedFileCount.title_en: 请求删除的文件路径数
requestedFileCount.title_zh: 请求删除的文件路径数

requestedObjectCount.description_en: The total number of deduplicated objects to be deleted
requestedObjectCount.description_zh: 去重后待删除的对象总数
requestedObjectCount.title_en: 去重后待删除的对象总数
requestedObjectCount.title_zh: 去重后待删除的对象总数

success.description_en: Indicates whether all delete operations succeeded. The value is true only if all deduplicated objects to be deleted are successfully deleted. If a partial deletion failure or exception occurs, the API directly returns an error
success.description_zh: 删除操作是否全部成功。仅当去重后的全部待删除对象均删除成功时返回 true；若发生部分删除失败或异常，接口将直接返回错误
success.title_en: 删除操作是否全部成功。仅当去重后的全部待删除对象均删除成功时返回 true；若发生部分删除失败或异常，接口将直接返回错误。
success.title_zh: 删除操作是否全部成功。仅当去重后的全部待删除对象均删除成功时返回 true；若发生部分删除失败或异常，接口将直接返回错误。
